Bill.BriefDescription: Revising the definition of "manager" under the state civil service law.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to managers under the state civil service law; andamending RCW 41.06.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.06.022 and 2002 c 354 s 207 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of this chapter, "manager" means any employee who: (1) ((Formulates statewide policy or)) Directs the work of anagency or agency subdivision; (2) Is responsible to administer one or more statewide policies orprograms of an agency or agency subdivision; (3) ((Manages, administers, and controls a local branch office ofan agency or agency subdivision, including the physical, financial, orpersonnel resources; (4))) Has substantial responsibility in personnel administration,legislative relations, public information, auditing, external communityliaison for a major statewide public safety program, or the preparationand administration of budgets; or (((5))) (4) Functionally is above the first level of supervision p. 1 SHB 1184and exercises authority that is not merely routine or clerical innature and requires the consistent use of independent judgment. No employee who ((is a member of the Washington managementservice)) meets this definition may be included in a collectivebargaining unit established under RCW 41.80.001 and 41.80.010 through41.80.130. Any individual may request the director of the departmentof personnel to review a position and determine if it meets thisdefinition. Appropriate requests shall be investigated by the directoror his or her designee.
